faqs.a:
These rules govern the recreational use by the public of Arvada/Blunn Reservoir. It
               is the policy of the city that the principal recreational use of Arvada/Blunn Reservoir
               is hereby limited to fishing for game fish as the term "fishing" is defined in C.R.S.
               § 33-1-102(16) and as the term "game fish" is defined in C.R.S. § 33-1-102(20).
(Code 1981, § 22-21; Ord. No. 2577, § 2, 12-19-1988; Ord. No. 2956, § 3, 2-15-1993)
